The Feathers Fly Part II#001.src: Oh... So you showed up! I'm glad, I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.dst: Oh... Demek geldin! Sevindim, gerçekten çok sevindim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#002.src: It's time for me to show the Growth Accelerator to the Corkians.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.dst: Büyüme Hızlandırıcısı'nı Corkian'lara gösterme vakti geldi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#003.src: Look, this time I'll really try and reward you well, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.dst: Bak, bu sefer seni gerçekten iyi ödüllendirmeye çalışacağım, tamam mı?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#004.src: Anyway! I have a plan. You see, I definitely can't easily get in the city.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.dst: Neyse! Bir planım var. Şehre öyle kolay kolay giremeyeceğim kesin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#005.src: The Corkians have a council where they deal with their issues. We can try getting an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.dst: Corkian'ların sorunlarını görüştükleri bir konseyi var. Bir huzura kabul ayarlamayı deneyebiliriz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#006.src: I know a way for me to get in the city. That's where you come in! There are some sentries to take care of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.dst: Şehre girmenin bir yolunu biliyorum. İşte burada sen devreye giriyorsun! Halletmen gereken birkaç nöbetçi var.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#007.src: They're really old models though, somehow. I'll give you a jammer I made for this. Right-Click a robot to use it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.dst: Nedense epey eski modeller ama. Bunun için yaptığım bir karıştırıcıyı vereceğim. Kullanmak için bir robota Sağ Tık yap!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#008.src: Once you jam one robot, you'll have to jam all others within {~} seconds! So try to plan ahead and locate them all before jamming one!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.dst: Bir robotu karıştırdığın an, diğerlerini de {~} saniye içinde karıştırman gerekecek! O yüzden önceden plan yap, birine dokunmadan hepsini bul!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#009.src: Tell me once you're ready. I'll throw you in there. I'll join you afterwards. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.dst: Hazır olunca söyle. Seni oraya fırlatacağım. Ben de sonra yanına gelirim. Görürsün!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#010.src: Well then, first off, take this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#011.src: Now, just stand still... I gotta try something on you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.dst: Şimdi kıpırdama... Senin üzerinde bir şey denemem lazım...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#012.src: Locate and jam all the robot sentries near the Corkus Clocktower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] within {~} seconds
The Feathers Fly Part II#012.dst: Corkus Saat Kulesi yakınındaki bütün robot nöbetçileri bul ve {~4} saniye içinde karıştır: [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#014.src: Thanks! These robots were harmless but hey, better safe than sorry right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.dst: Sağ ol! Bu robotlar zararsızdı ama olsun, tedbirli olmakta fayda var, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#015.src: Anyway, we need to get ready to meet the Corkian Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.dst: Neyse, Corkian Konseyi ile görüşmeye hazırlanmamız lazım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#016.src: And I think... I need a disguise. I don't like hiding myself, but I don't have a choice.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.dst: Ve galiba... Kılık değiştirmem gerekiyor. Saklanmayı sevmem ama başka çarem yok.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#017.src: Thanks to some plans I got, I know where to find some. Follow me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.dst: Elime geçen birkaç plan sayesinde nerede kıyafet bulacağımı biliyorum. Beni takip et!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#018.src: Here we are! I'm pretty sure we can find some outfits in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.dst: İşte geldik! Eminim burada birkaç kıyafet bulabiliriz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#019.src: I'll stand here to quickly hide in case anyone comes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.dst: Biri gelirse hemen saklanabilmek için burada duracağım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#020.src: Just look around, and come back with what you think looks better!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.dst: Etrafa bir bak, sana göre en güzel duranı getir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#021.src: Yeah, I am letting you choose my outfit. Aren't you lucky? Go and get me the fanciest clothes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.dst: Evet, kıyafetimi sana seçtiriyorum. Şanslısın, değil mi? Git de bana en şık kıyafetleri getir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#022.src: Pick an outfit to fit in with the Corkians and bring it to Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#022.dst: Corkian'lara uyum sağlayacak bir kıyafet seç ve Ava'ya götür: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#023.src: I'm trusting you. We Avos aren't exactly into... Fashion. Then again, they're not into Electromagic either, so what do I know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.dst: Sana güveniyorum. Biz Avos'lar pek... modayla ilgilenmeyiz. Gerçi onlar da Electromagic ile ilgilenmiyor, ben ne bileyim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#026.src: I feel like... I'm about to go to work.
The Feathers Fly Part II#026.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#027.src: At the very least, I'll probably blend in very well!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.dst: En azından muhtemelen çok iyi uyum sağlarım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#028.src: Now, I'm gonna be completely honest about this, so don't panic, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.dst: Şimdi, sana tamamen dürüst olacağım, o yüzden paniğe kapılma ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#029.src: I have... absolutely NO idea how we could even get an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.dst: Huzura nasıl kabul edileceğimiz hakkında... HİÇBİR fikrim yok.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#030.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one from the Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.dst: Bence ayrılıp Konsey'den nasıl kabul alacağımızı araştırmalıyız.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#031.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything! I'll ask around. You should too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.dst: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım! Ben etrafa soracağım. Sen de sor!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#032.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.dst: Son bir şey ama... Biraz tuhaf kaçacak, kusura bakma ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#034.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.dst: {u}, öyle mi? Bu... Güzel bir isim. Neyse, bol şans!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#037.src: I've already seen plenty of green in my lifetime, y'know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.dst: Hayatım boyunca yeterince yeşil gördüm zaten, biliyor musun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#038.src: Well, I know you folks sure do love money. Maybe we can get noticed with this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.dst: Siz insanların paraya bayıldığınızı biliyorum. Belki bununla dikkat çekebiliriz...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#039.src: Hmm... You know, this could actually work!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.dst: Hmm... Biliyor musun, bu gerçekten işe yarayabilir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#040.src: I have no idea how this audience things works but i could try to get people to notice me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.dst: Bu huzura kabul işi nasıl işliyor hiç bilmiyorum ama insanların beni fark etmesini sağlamaya çalışabilirim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#041.src: Well, we should split up and meet up later to see what information we have. Just ask around town!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.dst: Neyse, ayrılalım, sonra buluşup ne bilgi topladığımıza bakalım. Kasabada etrafa sor yeter!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#042.src: I'll be around the town center if you got any information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.dst: Bir bilgi bulursan kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#043.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if thats a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.dst: Son bir şey ama... Biraz tuhaf kaçacak, kusura bakma ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#048.src: Ya got good taste! I always wanted to explore the ocean, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.dst: Zevkin iyiymiş! Okyanusu keşfetmeyi hep istemişimdir, biliyor musun?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#049.src: Hey, thanks for helping me out so much. You've been such a huge help!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.dst: Hey, bana bu kadar yardım ettiğin için sağ ol. Çok büyük yardımın dokundu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#050.src: Well, this isn't over, of course. And to tell you the truth...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.dst: Ama tabii daha bitmedi. Doğruyu söylemek gerekirse...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#051.src: I, uh, have no idea how to get an audience... Sorry?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.dst: Şey, huzura nasıl kabul edileceğimiz hakkında hiçbir fikrim yok... Pardon?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#052.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.dst: Bence ayrılıp nasıl kabul alacağımızı araştırmalıyız.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#053.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.dst: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#057.src: Oh, and check this mask out! Time to be Ava the human!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.dst: Ha, bir de şu maskeye bak! İnsan Ava olma vakti!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#059.src: I feel like... I'm not even supposed to be wearing this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.dst: Sanki... bunu giymemem gerekiyormuş gibi hissediyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#060.src: This looks... Really, really cool though! ...Wait, where did you even find this?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.dst: Ama bu... Gerçekten çok havalı duruyor! ...Dur, sen bunu nereden buldun ki?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#061.src: I saw this dog, and... Well, that's besides the point. You'll tell me later!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.dst: Bir köpek gördüm, sonra... Neyse, konumuz bu değil. Sonra anlatırsın!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#062.src: Look, this audience thing is foreign to me but I feel like it won't really be an issue with this... thing.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.dst: Bak, bu huzura kabul işi bana yabancı ama bu... şeyle pek sorun olacağını sanmıyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#063.src: Well, we still need information on who to even talk to for that stuff... I'll ask around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.dst: Yine de bu iş için kiminle konuşacağımızı öğrenmemiz lazım... Ben etrafa sorarım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#064.src: You should too! I'll be around the town center! Come by once you got enough information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.dst: Sen de sor! Ben kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım! Yeterince bilgi toplayınca uğra!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#068.src: Ask around {p} for a way to get an audience with the Council. Ava is at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#068.dst: {p} çevresinde Konsey'e kabul almanın bir yolunu araştır. Ava'nın yeri: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#070.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.dst: Tamam, pek yasal sayılmaz AMA anlaşılan...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#071.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.dst: Huzura kabul davetiyesi satın alabileceğin bir çeşit... Şüpheli satıcı varmış?
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#072.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.dst: Başka yollar da vardır eminim, ama adam doğudaki şatoda olmalı, soldaki ilk kapı.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#073.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#073.dst: Ne yapacağın sana kalmış. Ben de... Aramaya devam ederim galiba.
The Feathers Fly Part II#073.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#074.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#074.dst: Huzura kabul mü? Ah, sen de onlardan birisin demek...
The Feathers Fly Part II#074.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#075.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.dst: Tamam tamam, şuradaki şatonun içinden geç, resepsiyon görevlisine varırsın.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#076.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.dst: Kabul alma şansın çok düşük. Birinden davetiyeyi çalsan daha şanslı olursun, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#077.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.dst: Lafı açılmışken... Galiba bir saat önce kasabanın öbür ucunda tam da bu oldu.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#078.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.dst: Belki davetiyesini kaybeden kişiye yardım edersin. Belki de çalarsın. Senin patronun değilim! Hadi, kış kış! Bitkilerime basma!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#079.dst: ...Ha? Huzura kabul mü? Delirdin mi sen?
The Feathers Fly Part II#079.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#080.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#080.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#081.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.dst: Ama gerçekten etkileyici olman lazım. Kaba olmak istemem ama sen yetmezsin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#082.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.dst: Gerçekten istiyorsan resepsiyon görevlisi şatoda. Doğuya git, hiç durma.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#083.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.dst: Ama bak ne diyeceğim, içeri giren onca kaçıktan sonra kadının keyfi hiç yerinde olmuyor.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#084.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#084.dst: Oh, selam. Ne arıyordun? ...Huzura kabul mü? Ne?
The Feathers Fly Part II#084.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#085.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.dst: Ah... Dur tahmin edeyim, makinen ne? Silah mı? Ne fırlatıyor? Kum mu?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#086.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.dst: Kusura bakma, biraz sinir bozucu da. Gerçekten kabul istiyorsan bunun için bir resepsiyon görevlisi var.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#087.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.dst: Başkalarına sor. Böyle işlerin adamı ben değilim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#088.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#088.dst: Oh, sen de mi huzura kabul almak istiyorsun?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#088.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#089.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.dst: Dünyanın göreceği en muhteşem robotik kılıçları dövüp duruyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#090.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.dst: Bak, resepsiyon görevlisinin yanına gidip onu deli gibi etkilemen lazım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#091.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.dst: Harika bir şey! En kötü ihtimalle ölürsün, ama şansın yaver giderse sadece kolun kırılır!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#092.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.dst: Doğudaki şatonun içinde, içinden geçip yürümeye devam et, eninde sonunda varırsın!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#093.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#093.dst: Hey, n'aber? Bende bir şey var!
The Feathers Fly Part II#093.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#094.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.dst: Hmm... Yani bir resepsiyon görevlisine gidebiliriz, o da bize kabul verebilir. Anladım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#095.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#095.dst: Yani içeri girip ona ne kadar havalı olduğumuzu göstereceğiz, bu da işe yarar herhalde, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#096.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#096.dst: Sorun değil, eminim ona kararlılığını falan göstermen yeterlidir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#097.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#097.dst: Ha, doğru, bende de bir şey vardı!
The Feathers Fly Part II#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#098.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#098.dst: Anlaşılan huzura kabul davetiyesi satan şüpheli bir herif varmış!
The Feathers Fly Part II#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#099.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#099.dst: Sanırım doğudaki şatoda, soldaki ilk kapıda? Ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#100.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#100.dst: Eminim başka yollar da vardır. Mesela şu resepsiyon görevlisi! Şatonun son odasında, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#101.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#101.dst: Hatta oraya kadar seni takip etmemi istersen ederim! Söylemen yeter!
The Feathers Fly Part II#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#103.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.dst: Hey evlat. Huzura kabul ha? Eheheh... Benim bir fikrim var...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#104.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.dst: Biliyor musun, almak zor... Çooook zor... Ama ben bir yolunu biliyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#105.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.dst: Çok ama çok basit... Bana [{~} Zümrüt Bloğu] vereceksin, gerisini ben hallederim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#106.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.dst: ...eheheh... Neyse, varsan beni nerede bulacağını biliyorsun!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#107.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.dst: Şu tuhaf satıcıyı buldun demek? Yoksa sen...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#108.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.dst: Yani... Aslında kabul almanın bir yolu olurdu, orası kesin. Ne istiyor?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#109.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.dst: [{~} Zümrüt Bloğu] mu? Çok mu bu? Ben insan değilim, biliyorsun! Neyse!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#110.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.dst: İstersen al, ama kabul almanın başka yolları da olduğuna eminim. Satın almak zorunda değilsin yani.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#111.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#111.dst: Neyse, ben... Aramaya devam ederim o zaman.
The Feathers Fly Part II#111.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#112.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.dst: Ooo, teşekkürler! Seninle iş yapmak bir zevkti keheh... Bol şans!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#114.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.dst: Cidden, derdiniz ne sizin! BEŞ DAKİKA rahat bırakılamaz mıyım?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#115.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.dst: Oh, pardoooon, biri mi sana buraya gelmeni söyledi? Beni "etkileyecek" misin?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#116.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#117.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.dst: İlgi çekici bir şeyin olunca gel. Güle güle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#118.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.dst: Oh? Satıcıyı da, kabul almanın başka bir yolunu da mı buldun?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#119.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.dst: [{~} Zümrüt Bloğu] mu? Çok mu bilmiyorum. Bence senin öbür yolunu deneyelim! Neymiş?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#120.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.dst: Huzura kabul için bir resepsiyon görevlisi mi var? Ne kadar kullanışlı! O zaman gidip onunla konuşalım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#121.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Oh... Well, that's not helpful. Maybe we can still give it a go?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.dst: Anlaşılan... Gerçekten çok zormuş? Oh... Pek işe yaramadı bu. Yine de bir denesek mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#122.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.dst: İstersen o tuhaf satıcıdan al, ama şu resepsiyon görevlisine de gitmeyi denemeliyiz. Seni oraya kadar takip etmemi istersen söyle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#123.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.dst: Tamam, gidelim o zaman. Bence satıcıdan uzak duralım, kanunla başımın belaya girmesini hiç istemem!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#124.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.dst: Demek satıcı orada, ha? Yürümeye devam edelim. O yerden de uzak duralım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#125.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.dst: Dur dur dur, sana az önce ne dedi- Ben kendimi küçültüp köşede durayım...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#126.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.dst: 'Ey, ya [{~} Zümrüt Bloğu] ya hiç! Merak etme, ikinize de kabul ayarlarım! Hanımın epey utangaçmış! İnan bana, derdini çok iyi anlıyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#130.src: And just WHO are you two, busting here like that?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.dst: Peki siz ikiniz KİMSİNİZ de buraya böyle dalıyorsunuz?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#131.src: Uh... Greetings... We've heard that we should come here for-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.dst: Şey... Merhabalar... Buraya gelmemiz gerektiğini duyduk, şey için-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#132.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? Shouldn't you be working at that time?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.dst: Gösterecek HERHANGİ bir şeyiniz var mı? Bu saatte işte olmanız gerekmiyor mu?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#133.src: No, it's just that I, well... Nevermind, I do have a thing to show, it's, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.dst: Hayır, şey, ben sadece... Boş verin, gösterecek bir şeyim var, şey...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#134.src: Not ANOTHER word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.dst: Tek KELİME daha istemem! Yeterince duydum! Belli ki ikinizin de vaktime değecek bir şeyi yok!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#135.src: Go back to your minimum wage job or something, but stay OUT of my room.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.dst: Asgari ücretli işinize falan dönün, ama odamdan UZAK durun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#136.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.dst: Vatandaşlar zor demişti, ha? Şaka değilmiş. Belki içeri dalmadan önce elimizde bir şey olmalıydı.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#137.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.dst: Bak, başka bir yol buluruz. Burada bitemez! Bize bir huzura kabul davetiyesi lazım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#138.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.dst: Ben kasaba meydanına dönüyorum, konuşmak istersen orada görüşürüz!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#139.src: That certainly didn't go well. But keep your head up! We got this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.dst: Pek iyi gitmediği kesin. Ama moralini bozma! Bunu başaracağız!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#140.src: There was a normal way to get an audience which is via a competition. We... missed it. So that'll have to pass.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.dst: Kabul almanın normal yolu bir yarışmaymış. Biz... onu kaçırdık. O yüzden o olmaz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#141.src: Now, for other... Unconventional ways... There was some panic by the Armour Merchant earlier today.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.dst: Gelelim diğer... Alışılmadık yollara... Bugün erken saatte Zırh Tüccarı'nın orada bir panik yaşanmış.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#142.src: Check it out if you want, I won't cause trouble. I'd rather be the friendly neighbourhood mechanic!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.dst: İstersen bir bak, ben olay çıkarmam. Mahallenin sevimli tamircisi olmayı tercih ederim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#143.src: There is apparently a dealer in the castle the receptionist's in, first entrance to the left. However, he charges emeralds...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.dst: Anlaşılan resepsiyon görevlisinin olduğu şatoda bir satıcı var, soldaki ilk giriş. Ama zümrüt istiyor...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#144.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.dst: Eminim bedava bir yolu da vardır. Sana güveniyorum! Seni takip etmemi istersen söyle yeter!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#145.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.dst: Umarım bu sefer doğru yaparız. Sen önden git, ben takip ederim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#146.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.dst: Oh, lütfen bana "huzura kabul" lafını etme!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#147.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#148.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.dst: Etrafa sordum, tabii ki kimse bir şey bilmiyor! Onu bulmaya çalışıyorum...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#149.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.dst: Bu han bir süredir tadilatta... Çalıntı bir şeyi saklamak için tam yeri!
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#150.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.dst: Ama yooo, tabii ki kilitli! Gerçi arkadan girilebilecek gibi görünüyor...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#151.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.dst: Şurada şüpheli bir ara sokak var gibi... Belki...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#152.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.dst: Off, bu kadar söylendiğim için kusura bakma. Seni tanımıyorum bile. Eminim şurada bir geçit vardır...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#153.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.dst: Dur dur dur, bir şeyin peşinde olduğuna eminim ama kasabada şaibeli işlere bulaşmasam iyi olur. İstediğini yap, ben kasaba meydanında takılacağım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#161.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.dst: Dur dur dur, bir şeyin peşinde olduğuna eminim ama kasabada şaibeli işlere bulaşmasam iyi olur. İstediğini yap, ben kasaba meydanında takılırım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#162.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#164.src: Oh god, not another duo. What do you want?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.dst: Aman tanrım, yine mi ikili. Ne istiyorsunuz?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#165.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.dst: Oh, şey, merhabalar! Size bir şey getirdik!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#166.src: And what would a mechanic have for- Wait, is that an invitation letter..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.dst: Bir tamircinin elinde ne olabilir ki- Dur, o bir davetiye mektubu mu..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#167.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.dst: Bu... Daha önce hiç olmamıştı. Konsey ne zaman müsait bakayım da bir kabul ayarlayayım...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#168.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.dst: İkiniz son derece şanslısınız. Gözlerime inanamıyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#169.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.dst: Umarım yarın sabah size uyar, çünkü Konsey nasılsa o saatte müsait.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#170.src: Sounds good? Hopefully it does, because you don't really have much of a choice. Well, you can leave now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.dst: Uygun mu? Umarım öyledir, çünkü pek seçeneğiniz yok. Neyse, artık gidebilirsiniz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#171.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#172.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.dst: Tamam, kabulden önce makineyi denememiz lazım. Birkaç ince ayar yaptım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#173.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.dst: Seni götürmemi istersen kuzey girişinin oralarda buluşalım. Yürümeyi seviyorsan Atölye'ye kendin de gidebilirsin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#175.src: So, how do I find help...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#176.src: I sure do love... Money. Totally!
The Feathers Fly Part II#176.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#229.src: It's difficult to get an audience? Well, it's worth a try, right? Maybe they'll see me as a wealthy lad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.dst: Kabul almak zor mu? Olsun, denemeye değer, değil mi? Belki beni zengin biri sanarlar!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#238.src: Why hello there! Greetings! Welcome! You are looking splendid, dear!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.dst: Ooo merhaba! Merhabalar! Hoş geldiniz! Harika görünüyorsun, canım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#239.src: Oh?! T-thank you... That's the first time someone told me such a thing!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.dst: Oh?! T-teşekkürler... İlk defa biri bana böyle bir şey söylüyor!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#240.src: Don't be silly dear, you're beautiful! Say, you're looking to be an investor, am I right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.dst: Saçmalama canım, çok güzelsin! Söylesene, yatırımcı olmak istiyorsun, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#241.src: ...Will that grant me an audience with the Council?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#242.src: Why of course! Is that other person your assistant? Great!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.dst: Elbette! Yanındaki de asistanın mı? Harika!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#243.src: I'd like you to show me you have what it takes to be a great investor, yes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.dst: Bana iyi bir yatırımcı olmak için gerekenlere sahip olduğunu göstermeni istiyorum, evet!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#244.src: Just hand over a mere [{~} Liquified Emeralds] and it's settled!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.dst: Sadece ufacık bir [{~} Sıvı Zümrüt] ver, mesele hallolsun!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#245.src: I- We'll... see what we can do.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#246.src: Look, I'm not good at being a human but even I know this is an absurd amount of money!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.dst: Bak, insan olmakta iyi değilim ama bunun saçma derecede çok para olduğunu ben bile biliyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#247.src: Do you think she'd actually take it? I'm not sure. We might have to find another way...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.dst: Sence gerçekten alır mı? Emin değilim. Başka bir yol bulmamız gerekebilir...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#248.src: I'll go back to the town center. It's up to you if you want to risk all that money, if you even have it! We'll figure something else out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.dst: Ben kasaba meydanına dönüyorum. O kadar parayı riske atmak sana kalmış, tabii o kadar paran varsa! Başka bir şey buluruz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#249.src: Oh, you're back! With the money I see! Surprising! I like you two!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.dst: Oh, döndünüz! Parayla da gelmişsiniz! Şaşırdım! Sizi sevdim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#250.src: What? Of course I'm not taking the money! I just wanted to know if you had what it takes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.dst: Ne? Tabii ki parayı almayacağım! Sadece gerekene sahip misiniz, onu öğrenmek istedim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#251.src: Now I'm sure you're not a scam. Let me see when the council's available...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.dst: Artık dolandırıcı olmadığınıza eminim. Konsey ne zaman müsait bakayım...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#252.src: Thanks! I'll try not to disappoint you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.dst: Teşekkürler! Sizi hayal kırıklığına uğratmamaya çalışacağım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#253.src: You are two lucky people! We do have a free spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.dst: Çok şanslı iki kişisiniz! Boş bir yerimiz var!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#254.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you! We'll see you there then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.dst: Umarım yarın sabah size uyar! Orada görüşürüz o zaman!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#256.src: That's crazy! [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? Is that how the world works?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.dst: Bu delilik! [{~} Sıvı Zümrüt] mü? Dünya böyle mi işliyor?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#257.src: It's just... I honestly don't care about listening to the law anymore.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.dst: Sadece... Açıkçası artık kanuna uymak umurumda değil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#258.src: Let's just get that audience. For one, there's some girl panicking by the Armour Merchant! Maybe she could help?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.dst: Şu kabulü alalım artık. Mesela Zırh Tüccarı'nın orada panik yapan bir kız var! Belki o yardım edebilir?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#259.src: As for another way, I don't know if you paid attention on our way to the receptionist, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.dst: Başka bir yol olarak da, resepsiyon görevlisine giderken dikkat ettin mi bilmiyorum ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#260.src: There is apparently a dealer in there. He does charge money too, though. But surely not as much as that... wretched... lady! ...Sorry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.dst: Anlaşılan orada bir satıcı var. Gerçi o da para istiyor. Ama o... iğrenç... kadın kadar değildir herhalde! ...Pardon.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#280.src: Oh! Why hello there you two! How may I be of assistance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.dst: Oh! Merhaba ikinize de! Size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#282.src: You're looking splendid dear! Now, are you-- Wait, you have a letter?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.dst: Harika görünüyorsun canım! Peki, sen-- Dur, mektubunuz mu var?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#286.src: You know miss, you look like you could've been a great investor. Oh well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.dst: Biliyor musunuz hanımefendi, harika bir yatırımcı olabilirmişsiniz gibi duruyorsunuz. Neyse, bol şans!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#287.src: If you want a tip, well... There's a new guy in the Council, so he might be easier to impress!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.dst: Bir tavsiye isterseniz... Konsey'de yeni biri var, onu etkilemek daha kolay olabilir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#773.dst: Corkus'ta daha önce kimse böyle bir şey yapmadı. Bize anlatacağın ya da göstereceğin bir şey var mı?

The Feathers Fly Part II#776.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#777.dst: Ben tam olarak sizin gibi değilim.

The Feathers Fly Part II#798.src: Did you know, or did she trick you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#798.dst: Biliyor muydun, yoksa seni kandırdı mı?
The Feathers Fly Part II#798.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#799.src: I swear didn't know! Believe me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#799.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#800.src: Sure, and then what? What did you hope to accomplish?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#800.dst: Peki, sonra ne olacaktı? Neyi başarmayı umdun?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#800.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#801.src: I'm unsure if I should be impressed, distressed or enraged. So I think I'll just be all three. Ava, congratulations.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.dst: Etkilensem mi, üzülsem mi, öfkelensem mi bilemedim. Sanırım üçünü birden yapacağım. Tebrikler, Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#802.src: But... Why... I don't get it. I don't get the Avos. I don't get humans...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.dst: Ama... Neden... Anlamıyorum. Avos'ları anlamıyorum. İnsanları anlamıyorum...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#803.src: What's so wrong about me? Why shouldn't I do electromagic? Why??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.dst: Benim nem yanlış? Neden Electromagic yapmamalıyım? Neden??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#804.src: Oh, darling. You impress then enrage me, and now you want me to pity you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.dst: Ah, canım. Önce beni etkiledin, sonra öfkelendirdin, şimdi de sana acımamı istiyorsun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#805.src: You know, your kind has always been...
The Feathers Fly Part II#805.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#806.src: So archaic. Always with their spirituality, their flora, their beliefs, their traditions...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.dst: Öyle eski kafalı ki. Hep maneviyatları, bitkileri, inançları, gelenekleri...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#807.src: And you, you're fiddling not only with nature, but also with OUR things.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.dst: Ve sen, sadece doğayla değil, BİZİM işlerimizle de oynuyorsun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#808.src: Somehow, you're able to control electromagic? I guess it's not exclusive to humans, then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.dst: Bir şekilde Electromagic'i kontrol edebiliyorsun? Demek ki insanlara özgü değilmiş.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#809.src: Even then, I see no reason as to why we should let you interact with us. You shouldn't be here.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.dst: Öyle bile olsa bizimle iş yapmana izin vermemiz için hiçbir sebep görmüyorum. Burada olmamalısın.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#810.src: I think... I finally get it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#810.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#811.src: I do, really. The truth is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#811.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#814.src: I come up to you with an incredible breakthrough, and you can't even see past my feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.dst: Size inanılmaz bir buluşla geliyorum ve tüylerimin ötesini göremiyorsunuz bile.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#815.src: Alright, I've heard enough. That's it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#817.src: Don't you dare touch- Gah! I'll show you. I'll show everyone what you're missing out on!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.dst: Sakın bana dokunma- Ah! Göstereceğim size. Neyi kaçırdığınızı herkese göstereceğim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#818.src: What just... Everyone! Dismissed! What is that girl doing?! I'll go after her! Nodise, Maxie, you go and help Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.dst: Bu da ne... Herkes! Toplantı bitti! O kız ne yapıyor?! Ben peşinden gidiyorum! Nodise, Maxie, siz gidip Sybil'e yardım edin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#823.src: You're crying?! Aw... There, there. It's alright, you made it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.dst: Ağlıyor musun?! Ah... Tamam, tamam. Geçti, başardın.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#902.src: God, I hate to say it, but her mask was flawless.

The Feathers Fly Part II#907.dst: ... Biliyor muydun, yoksa seni kandırdı mı? Söyleyeceklerine çok dikkat et.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#932.src: I didn't really doubt you with your armour. We have a few questions though!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.dst: O zırhla senden pek şüphelenmedim zaten. Yine de birkaç sorumuz var!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#979.src: Huh, that armour's actually powerful. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll show everyone what I'm really capable of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.dst: Hıh, o zırh gerçekten güçlüymüş. Şimdi izin verirseniz, herkese neler yapabildiğimi göstereceğim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#982.src: Well... Mo'in, {u}. I was thinking about catching up with you and all after the audience, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.dst: Şey... Mo'in, {u}. Kabulden sonra seninle hasret gidermeyi düşünüyordum ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#983.src: I guess we don't really have time for that now, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.dst: Galiba şu an buna pek vaktimiz yok, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#984.dst: Vay Maxie, ne güzel zaman yönetimi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#985.src: Sybil... This is no time to quarrel.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#986.dst: Az önce olanları gördün mü? Eminim şimdi bile Avos'ları savunmaya devam edecek!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#988.src: Nodise... You probably should stay here too. We-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.dst: Nodise... Sen de burada kalsan iyi olur. Biz-

The Feathers Fly Part II#989.dst: N-Neler oluyor?! Aman tanrım, hemen oraya koşuyorum!

The Feathers Fly Part II#991.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#992.src: So what? Here to fix your mistakes? Help your insane bird friend?

The Feathers Fly Part II#992.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#993.dst: Böyle bir bitkinin birkaç saniyede büyümesi... İnanamıyorum.

The Feathers Fly Part II#994.dst: Maxie arkadaşın, değil mi? O çoktan içeride. Sen de gitmelisin.

The Feathers Fly Part II#995.src: I think you gotta reach the top to take care of this. Maybe multiple times.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.dst: Bunu halletmek için tepeye çıkman gerekiyor galiba. Belki birkaç kez.

The Feathers Fly Part II#997.dst: Ava'nın {p} bölgesini yerle bir etmesini durdur: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#998.src: {u}!! I'm sure Efena told you already, no time to talk!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.dst: {u}!! Eminim Efena sana söylemiştir, konuşacak vakit yok!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#999.src: Apparently, there's something up there! Try to reach the top! There are strange plants around, see if that helps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.dst: Anlaşılan yukarıda bir şey var! Tepeye çıkmaya çalış! Etrafta tuhaf bitkiler var, işe yarıyor mu bak!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.src: ...You're here. Here to fix my own mistakes, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.src: And then, here to take me, I suppose. Right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.dst: Sonra da beni götürmeye, herhalde. Değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.src: Y'know, I noticed you always were one to follow orders. Well, what you're lookin' for is on top of the plant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.dst: Biliyor musun, hep emirlere uyan biri olduğunu fark ettim. Neyse, aradığın şey bitkinin tepesinde.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.src: I... I'm not gonna fight back. There's no point. Just... Just go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.dst: Ben... Karşılık vermeyeceğim. Bir anlamı yok. Sadece... Sadece git.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.src: Woah! You did something! You should try that again!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.dst: Vay! Bir şey yaptın! Bir daha dene!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.src: I - I really didn't want this. I wanted to help people, {u}! Not... not...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.dst: B- Ben bunu hiç istemedim. İnsanlara yardım etmek istedim, {u}! Bunu... bunu değil...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.src: I sure have impressed everyone. So I guess not all's lost, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.dst: Herkesi etkilediğim kesin. Demek ki her şey kaybolmadı, ha?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.src: I'll be the talk of an entire nation!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.src: Gosh, I really am going crazy aren't I?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.src: I just... I don't know what to do... I reached rock bottom...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.dst: Ben sadece... Ne yapacağımı bilmiyorum... Dibe vurdum...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.src: I screwed up with my people, then with the humans, then...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.dst: Önce kendi halkımla işleri berbat ettim, sonra insanlarla, sonra...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.src: Could you tell her something for me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.dst: Ona benden bir şey söyleyebilir misin?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.src: Tell her that... I'm not that mad.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.dst: Ona... o kadar da kızgın olmadığımı söyle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.src: This... While destructive, it's impressive, and...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.dst: Bu... Yıkıcı olsa da etkileyici ve...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.src: Whatever, just tell her! People will think I lost my mind, it's fine!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.dst: Neyse, söyle işte! İnsanlar aklımı kaçırdığımı düşünür, olsun!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.src: I'd like to talk to her. I assume she'll just flee, but... You should try!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.dst: Onunla konuşmak isterim. Herhalde kaçar ama... Denemelisin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.src: ...What? Do you have anythin' to tell me before I leave?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.dst: ...Ne? Ben gitmeden önce söyleyeceğin bir şey var mı?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.src: Huh?! The president herself isn't too mad at me? What??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.dst: Ha?! Başkanın kendisi bana o kadar kızgın değil mi? Ne??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.src: Are you trying to make me get down and get arrested? You know I... I can't believe you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.dst: Aşağı inip tutuklanmamı mı sağlamaya çalışıyorsun? Biliyorsun ben... Sana inanamıyorum...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.src: I want to, but... Have you seen how she was during the audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.dst: İsterdim ama... Kabulde nasıl davrandığını gördün mü?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.src: I can't trust you, {u}. There's no way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.src: I regret this... I shouldn't have acted this way, this wasn't supposed to happen, I...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.dst: Pişmanım... Böyle davranmamalıydım, bunun olmaması gerekiyordu, ben...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.src: I can't stay, {u}. The president's one thing, but the others...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.dst: Kalamam, {u}. Başkan bir şey, ama diğerleri...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.src: No point fighting back, even though I could totally manage. I feel bad for that other girl now. Go, then... Stop my machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.dst: Karşılık vermenin anlamı yok, rahatlıkla yapabilirdim gerçi. Şimdi o öbür kıza üzülüyorum. Git o zaman... Makinemi durdur.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.src: Hmpf. Did take that thing down?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.src: Oh she better be around here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.src: Wait, under the rubble, I see something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.dst: Durun, enkazın altında bir şey görüyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1113.dst: Orada! {u}, iyi misin? Beni duyuyor musun?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1113.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.src: Look, I'll give you a mission. Find Ava with {u}, and tell her this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.dst: Bak, sana bir görev veriyorum. {u} ile birlikte Ava'yı bul ve ona şunu söyle...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.src: Mo'in, {u}! You're fine! I'm so glad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.src: You're something of a hero, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.dst: Biliyor musun, sen bir nevi kahramansın.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.src: That was some really nice job back there! But now...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.dst: Orada gerçekten çok iyi iş çıkardın! Ama şimdi...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.src: Well, the town's fine, but... I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.dst: Kasaba iyi durumda ama... Ava'yı bulma görevi bana verildi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.src: From what I've gathered, you worked with her and know where to go, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.dst: Duyduğuma göre onunla çalışmışsın ve nereye gideceğini biliyorsun, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.src: Oh, you told Ava about Efena? And she... she fled. Right. Well, I'm not surprised!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.dst: Oh, Ava'ya Efena'yı anlattın mı? O da... kaçtı. Doğru. Eh, hiç şaşırmadım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.src: Trust me, we want to help that poor Avo. Let's just find her, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.dst: İnan bana, o zavallı Avo'ya yardım etmek istiyoruz. Önce bir bulalım onu, tamam mı?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.src: Tell me whenever you're ready, and we'll go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.src: Find Ava at the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.src: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.dst: Avos şefi ondan bir kez bahsetmişti ama burası çılgınca!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.src: You... I assume you're here to take me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.src: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.dst: Hadi o zaman. Yap. Kaybedecek bir şeyim kalmadı. Zaten her şeyimi kaybettim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.src: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.dst: Acımanı istemiyorum. Kimsem yok. İşini kendine zorlaştırıyorsun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.src: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.dst: Başkan seni ölüme falan mahkûm etmedi... Aslında tam tersi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.src: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.dst: Ne demek istiyorsun? Sana neden güveneyim?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.src: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.src: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.dst: Güzel yer. Kültürümüzün seni nasıl etkilediği apaçık belli.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.src: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.src: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.dst: Oh, "affetmek" çok ağır bir kelime, Ava. Bak.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.src: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.dst: Bence hepimizin bundan çıkaracağı bir iki ders var. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.src: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.dst: Kanunu çiğnedin, bu yüzden kasabaya girmen yasak. Anladın mı?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.dst: Önce Avos'lar, sonra siz, ha. Demek başa döndük.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.dst: Bak, o makinen etkileyici. Yalan söylemiyorum. Yeteneklisin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.dst: Ama kesinlikle büyük bir hata yaptın. Ben de yaptım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.src: I guess you and I really learnt what acting in the heat of the moment means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.dst: Galiba ikimiz de anın sıcaklığıyla hareket etmenin ne demek olduğunu öğrendik, ha.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.dst: Bir çeşit... Uzlaşmam var. İkimiz için. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.dst: Evet, ben... seninle çalışmak istiyorum. Senden öğrenmek.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.dst: Electromagic'te benden çok daha iyi olduğun belli, o yüzden...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.dst: Neye ihtiyacın varsa sağlamaya hazırım. Arada bir sana yardım ederim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.dst: Çok uzun süredir yalnızsın, Ava. Maxie'yi sana ödünç veriyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.dst: *kıkırdar* Şaka yapıyorum. Konseyin geri kalanının henüz haberi yok.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.dst: Seni öldüremeyeceğimi biliyorsun. Avos'ların bunu nasıl karşılayacağını düşünebiliyor musun? Sürgün edilmiş olsan bile...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.dst: Ama öyle bir şey istemiyorum da. Sana gelince, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.dst: Sana birkaç şey vereceğim. Sen olmasaydın işlerin nasıl gideceğini hayal bile edemiyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.dst: Artık herkesten sürgün edildin, Ava. Bunun mutlu son olmadığını biliyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.dst: Ama öyle olsa fazla kolay olurdu, sence de öyle değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.dst: Belki ileride mutlu sonuna kavuşursun. Ama artık yalnız olmamakla yetinebilirsin, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.dst: Hoşça kal, Ava. Kim bilir, belki arada bir uğrarım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.src: ...? If you stop by the Workshop later, maybe I'll have some things for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.dst: ...? Sonra Atölye'ye uğrarsan, belki benim de sana verecek bir şeylerim olur.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1164.dst: Hoşça kal. Teşekkürler. Her şey için.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes. After all, you're very stylish!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.dst: Hoşça kal, Ava. Kim bilir, belki arada bir uğrarım. Ne de olsa çok şıksın!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.dst: Hoşça kal, Ava. Kim bilir, belki arada bir uğrarım. Belki o zamana kadar o zırhını çözmüş olursun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.dst: Bu modelle ilgili daha fazla bilgi için lütfen Cerid ile iletişime geçin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Herhangi bir sorunuz varsa, bilin ki sorulacak doğru makine kesinlikle ben değilim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.dst: Hey, sorun yok. Biz iyi olacağız.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: Biliyor musun, Atölye'n beklediğimden çok daha güzelmiş.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, yardımın için sağ ol. Beni tam bir yetenekle tanıştırdın!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: İnan bana, reddedilmenin nasıl bir his olduğunu bilirim. Herkes bilir galiba, kendince.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Şef'ten daha iyi biri, orası kesin...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1284.dst: Yani... Maxie, değil mi? Doğru mu?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1284.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, buraya geri geldiğinde benim aletlerimden bazılarını alabileceksin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava
